description: THIS CHANGES WHAT A LIVE CAMPAIGN MAY SPEND, and it is the only tool in the Apple Ads suggestion/recommendation family that touches money. Applying a daily-budget recommendation raises that campaign’s daily budget to Apple’s suggested amount; applying a target-CPA recommendation moves the CPA its auto-bidder chases. REQUIRES confirm:true, and the refusal you get without it is built from the recommendation READ BACK FROM APPLE — it names the campaign, states the daily budget current -> recommended (Apple keeps no current target CPA anywhere readable, so a target-CPA refusal states the recommended target against the campaign’s average CPA so far), and quotes Apple’s own projected spend over the next seven days — so you are confirming a specific change to a specific campaign rather than confirming that you pressed a button. Apple publishes no dry-run for this call; that refusal IS the preview, and it dispatches nothing. An id Hermoso cannot read back from Apple right now (unknown, expired, another app, or Apple not answering) is refused even WITH confirm:true. Pass amount to apply a DIFFERENT number than Apple suggested; omit it to take Apple’s. The campaign’s STATUS IS NOT TOUCHED: this moves a ceiling, it never enables or pauses anything, and it does not make a paused campaign start spending. Only an AVAILABLE recommendation can be applied and applying is TERMINAL. APPLIED is reported only from READ-BACKS, never from Apple’s acknowledgement: a daily budget only when the re-read CAMPAIGN carries the new budget; a target CPA (which Apple stores on no campaign) only when the re-read campaign exists and the recommendation re-queries as APPLIED. Anything less comes back NOT CONFIRMED and says which read failed. Free to call; the spending it enables is real.

amount.description: Override Apple’s suggestion with your own decimal amount, e.g. "500.00". Omit to apply what Apple suggested.

confirm.description: REQUIRED true. Without it nothing changes and the refusal states the campaign and the exact budget or CPA change.

currency.description: ISO 4217; defaults to the currency of the recommendation Apple quoted (then the ad account’s). A different currency from the recommendation’s is refused — an Apple Ads account cannot mix currencies.

id.description: REQUIRED — the recommendation id from list_apple_ads_recommendations.

promotedObjectId.description: REQUIRED — the same app or brand id the recommendation was queried for.

name: apply_apple_ads_recommendation
title: Apply an Apple Ads recommendation
